answer: In an AI-agent economy, sybil attacks are resisted by mandating that every new identity perform a unique, non-reusable proof-of-computation tied to its private key before gaining attestation rights. The hollow claim of unlimited free identities fails because the attacker must expend real CPU cycles and energy for each fake, as the challenge quill etches a fresh puzzle that no shared zephyr of cached work can solve. This imposes a linear cost in hardware and electricity, making large-scale identity farming economically unviable.
